I recently visited Satkar Sweets and Snacks and was deeply disappointed by my experience, primarily due to severe hygiene and mismanagement issues.

Upon entering, we noticed Deepu, the staff member assigned to our order of garlic bread with corn, brooming the shop. While cleanliness is crucial in any food establishment, it was concerning to see him transition directly from sweeping the floor to food preparation without proper sanitation protocols.

Despite washing his hands post-brooming, Deepu proceeded to make our order without wearing gloves. When we requested that he put on gloves, he showed utter disappointment, which was both unprofessional and troubling. He placed the bread in his hand and then, with the other hand, began scooping cheese from a container, exposing our food to potential contamination.

When we asked to cancel our order and requested a refund, the staff reacted poorly, creating a scene rather than addressing our concerns professionally. This escalated further when my mother approached the owner for assistance. Instead of offering a solution, he disrespected her, which added to our frustration.

The overall experience at Satkar Sweets and Snacks was marred by inadequate hygiene practices and unprofessional behavior. It’s crucial for any eatery to prioritize cleanliness and customer service, and unfortunately, this establishment fell short in both areas. I cannot recommend Satkar Sweets and Snacks based on this experience.

featured_reviews.name: Girish Naik
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the perfect place to indulge in clean and delightful sweets along with mouthwatering snacks. Though standing to eat is necessary as there's no seating, the scrumptious sabudana wada, batata wada, and kachori will leave you wanting more. While prices might be slightly higher, the exquisite taste makes it worthwhile. Beyond the sweets, they also stock various kitchen staples at reasonable rates, making it a unique blend of a hotel, sweets shop, and grocery store. For authentic Maharashtrian delights, their wide range of sweets and dishes near Mulund station on the East side is a must-visit. Additionally, their 30-year legacy ensures the preservation of authentic Marathi flavors, making it an ideal place to buy Testy Diwali Faral, Upwaas items, and snacks.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Dhuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Perfect place to get absolutely clean and delicious sweets. The place is not only a go to for sweets but also serves mouthwatering snacks.
Although there is no place to sit, and one has to stand and eat right in front of shop; the delicious sabudana wada, batata wada, kachori and other limited menu items (availability subject to the day wise menu) shall make your mouth water. featured_reviews.name: Dad Doo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had heard a lot about this place, so when I was in Mulund East I visited the place.
I had eaten their Vadapav. The pav was soft & fresh and the vada was piping hot & tasty but their red dry chutney was not at all spicy. ₹23 for vadapav is bit pricey.

Ambience is absolutely zero as it is on the busy station road market & has no place to sit & enjoy the food.
Even water for washing hands was missing.

It is a typical Maharashtrian snacks eatery with old furniture & slow staff.
I didn't understand why is it a bhojnalaya when only few food items are available daily, rest others like kothimbir wadi, thalipeeth are available on specific days.

Although I tasted their Vadapav only, I am pretty sure that rest ALL items will be tasty.
I will definitely visit again & try the other items too.

featured_reviews.name: Suhail Kazi
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for authentic, high-quality Indian sweets and snacks, Bhadai Sweets is the place to visit! I recently indulged in some of their most popular items—samosa, dhokla, khandvi, gujiya, and rasgulla—and I must say, the taste was better than Bikaner! Every bite was a delightful experience, and the quality of ingredients truly stood out.

Savoury Delights

I started with their samosa, and it was nothing short of perfection. The outer crust was golden brown, crispy, and flaky, with no excessive oiliness. The stuffing inside was packed with well-seasoned mashed potatoes, green peas, and aromatic spices. Unlike many places where samosas can be bland or too spicy, Bhadai Sweets strikes the perfect balance of flavors.

Next, I tried their dhokla, and it was incredibly soft, light, spongy, and airy. The mild tangy-sweet taste, combined with the fresh green chili tempering, enhanced the flavor even further. The accompanying chutney added a burst of freshness, making it one of the best dhoklas I have ever had.

The khandvi was another highlight of my experience. Each roll was thin, smooth, and perfectly textured, melting effortlessly in my mouth. The seasoning of mustard seeds, curry leaves, and grated coconut added the perfect finishing touch. It was so flavorful and well-prepared that it surpassed my expectations.

Irresistible Sweets

Now, coming to the sweets—this is where Bhadai Sweets truly excels!

The gujiya was nothing short of spectacular. The outer layer was crispy and golden, while the inside was richly stuffed with premium-quality khoya, dry fruits, and a hint of cardamom. It was fried to perfection, giving it an irresistible crunch, yet it remained light and non-greasy. Every bite was packed with traditional flavors, making it the best gujiya I have ever had.

The rasgulla, however, was the real showstopper. Unlike many places where rasgullas can be overly sweet or too dense, Bhadai’s rasgulla was perfectly soft, spongy, and soaked in just the right amount of sugar syrup. It had a delicate texture and a lightness that made it an absolute joy to eat.

Why Bhadai Sweets is Better Than Bikaner?

While I have always been a fan of Bikaner, I have to say that Bhadai Sweets has taken the taste, quality, and authenticity to the next level. Their ingredients feel fresher, the flavors are more balanced, and the preparation is more refined. The hygiene standards are top-notch, and the staff is friendly and attentive. Even the packaging is neat, clean, and well-thought-out, ensuring that the food reaches you in perfect condition.Bhadai Sweets has truly impressed me with its incredible taste, freshness, and authenticity. Whether you’re craving a crispy snack like samosa, a soft and spongy dhokla, or rich and decadent sweets like gujiya and rasgulla, this place delivers perfection in every bite.

If you’re a lover of Indian snacks and sweets, I highly recommend visiting Bhadai Sweets. It has certainly become my new favorite, and I can’t wait to try more from their extensive menu.

⭐ Overall Rating: 5/5 – Better than Bikaner!
